cultivar_warning: Zenodo record 15635995 describes 100 aligned apple point clouds but does not identify the cultivar. Do not claim Fuji specificity without independent metadata.

provenance.source_title: 3D high-resolution point cloud of apple shapes and UAV videos in apple orchards

training.parameterization: common Fibonacci directions with inverse-angular-neighbor radial interpolation
training.centering: midpoint of per-axis robust quantile bounds; no scale normalization
training.pca: SVD of sample-by-direction radial matrix; deformation_mm is one standard deviation
